scenarios.title: Development static HTTP workspace
scenarios.summary: Private typed adapter fixture; no authored curriculum count.
scenarios.objective: Serve the supplied Report ready page from report.example.test now and after a separate next start. Deny its supplied private path with HTTP403. Keep observer.example.test healthy and preserve its page and the private file contents. Active configuration must match saved text; equivalent supported config is accepted.
steps: Check current root, roles and tree path
scenarios.explanation: The public root and its matching grant now reach the supplied page, while the more specific private directory is denied. Saved and active documents agree and the independent next-start checks confirm the saved policy. The observer and private file were preserved.
hints: Compare DocumentRoot with the fixed virtual file paths.
Saving does not reload the active source; a healthy current site can still have a wrong next start.
scenarios.simplifications: Unbundled technical fixture,2026-10-25. Closed Apache2.4-style static config and typed HTTP outcomes only; no sockets, Linux aliases, workers, TLS, authentication, proxy or full Apache conformance.

apache_static_teaching.prerequisite_note: Inspect saved configuration and the active server separately. This example teaches the supplied static-serving grammar; it runs no host server.

concepts.title: Three separate layers
concepts.text: Saved configuration is text for the next start. Active configuration is what the running virtual server uses now. Supplied static files are live: saving a page changes later responses without reloading the config.

concepts.title: Read the document
concepts.text: Listen chooses a destination port. A VirtualHost block names a site and its DocumentRoot. Directory rules allow or deny fixed folders; the more specific child rule replaces the parent. DirectoryIndex chooses a supplied file for a directory request. Only the documented literal subset is supported.

concepts.title: Save is not Reload
concepts.text: Insert copies example text into the independent draft only. Save it explicitly, then Reload the running virtual server. Start while already active is a no-op. Check work also tests a new start using saved text and current files without changing your active server.

apache_static_teaching.example_description: Restore the gallery site while the attendant site and private file remain intact. Both current requests and a separate next-start test must serve the right public page and deny the private path.

example_actions.title: Save the corrected gallery document
example_actions.explanation: Change the gallery DocumentRoot and matching Directory grant from archive to report. The private child Directory remains denied; the attendant site stays unchanged.

<VirtualHost *:8080>
ServerName attendant.example.test

<Directory "/practice/gallery/srv/observer">
Require all granted
</Directory>
</VirtualHost>

example_actions.title: Activate the saved gallery document
example_actions.explanation: Use the virtual Reload control. It parses the saved document before changing active serving; this is not a real Linux command.

try_change.description: Save the old archive-root document without reloading. Inspect why the current gallery still works but the next-start tests fail; restore the corrected document to repair.
